summary: Iteration 2 - tested new additions: kisam field on plots, PATCH /api/transactions/{id} (Mark Paid), dashboard total_withdrawn, Plot Detail Tabs (Paid/Withdrawals) and 4-col stat grid. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests passed (5 prior + 6 new). Frontend: end-to-end Mark Paid flow verified - withdrawal of 50000 created, switched to Withdrawals tab, Mark Paid clicked, txn moved to Paid tab and Total Paid stat increased by 50000. Kisam badge visible on dashboard PlotCard and PlotDetail header. 4-col grid intact with no extra Withdrawn card on top.
critical_code_review_comments: PlotDetailPage.jsx: Tabs/TabSummary defined inline inside an IIFE inside JSX render. Works fine but extracting to a child component (e.g., <PlotTransactionsTabs/>) would improve readability and avoid recomputation on every render.
Backend list_plots and get_plot use p.setdefault('kisam', 'Other') for backward compat with old docs. Consider a one-time migration script to backfill.
PATCH endpoint correctly returns 404 for missing id and 422 for invalid Literal values, matches request spec.
Backend total_withdrawn aggregation iterates all txns once; O(N) which is fine.
seed_data_creation: Test plots/txns auto-cleaned via pytest fixture teardown + post-test cleanup script removed TEST_E2E_Kisam plot.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test ids covered: plot-kisam-select, plot-kisam-option-{Residential|Commercial|Agricultural|Industrial|Other}, plot-detail-kisam, tab-paid, tab-withdrawals, paid-summary, withdrawn-summary, txn-mark-paid-{i}, txn-mark-paid-mobile-{i}, stat-plot-paid-value (numeric value cell). Dashboard plot card kisam badge text is uppercase via CSS — assert via .toUpperCase() or case-insensitive match. Backend pytest covers: kisam default 'Other' when omitted, kisam round-trip for all 5 values, PATCH 404/422, PATCH withdrawal->Plot Payment updates dashboard total_paid (+amt) and total_withdrawn (-amt) and per-plot total_paid.
rca of the issue: No issues found. Both new features work end-to-end.
